name: Infected Gas Station [HORROR]
desc:
You’ve finally been hired for the night shift at a remote gas station deep in the forest. It’s only a few nights of work, but some rules must be followed to survive.

⚠️ Contains horror elements such as jumpscares, eerie ambience, and unsettling visuals. Play with caution.

🎧 Headphones and max graphics recommended.
📔 The game was inspired by @lost_archive5 on social medias.

👻 Can you survive all 5 nights at the gas station?
